scenario.summary: Threat actors are targeting unauthenticated Ollama AI servers to hijack compute resources and linked cloud model subscriptions (LLMjacking). Beyond resource theft, attackers use path traversal vulnerabilities (CVE-2024-37032) to read sensitive host files like /etc/shadow and establish persistence via system configuration hijacking.

meta.rationale: Focus on cloud and hosting network ranges (OVH, Hetzner, DigitalOcean) where developers may have 'expensed' servers outside of standard CMDB oversight.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary is identifying unauthenticated AI runtimes exposed to the internet and using them to verify connectivity or establish command-and-control via outbound tunneling services.

blind_spots.risk: A simple GET to /api/tags is visible, but the destructive manifest digest payload in a POST /api/pull body is often missed by standard proxy logs.
blind_spots.question: whether an /api/pull request contained a path-traversal payload
blind_spots.requires: hb_http_activity with full request body capture
blind_spots.remediation: Enable verbose logging for reverse proxies fronting AI infrastructure.

blind_spots.risk: Without process-to-network mapping on unmanaged VPS hosts, we cannot confirm the AI runtime initiated the callback versus a standard developer tool.

blind_spots.requires: hb_network_connection with process mapping on all VPS hosts
blind_spots.remediation: Deploy endpoint agents to all expensed cloud compute.

hunt.name: Exposed AI Runtime Probing and Callbacks
hunt.description: This hunt identifies AI runtimes like Ollama and Jupyter exposed to the public internet without authentication. It then searches for evidence of active misuse by correlating this exposure with outbound DNS callbacks to free tunneling services and suspicious HTTP probes against sensitive API endpoints. By combining external exposure data with internal telemetry, the hunt distinguishes between simple misconfiguration and active server-side request forgery (SSRF) or persistence attempts.

config.beyond_detection: A single rule on Ollama's port cannot distinguish between a researcher's honeypot and a corporate asset. This hunt correlates external scan data with internal behavioural pivots (DNS and API probing) to settle on a compromise verdict.

config.content: SELECT domain_or_ip, port, product, provider FROM hb_exposed_assets WHERE (LOWER(product) LIKE '%ollama%' OR LOWER(product) LIKE '%jupyter%' OR port IN (11434, 8888, 8501, 8000))
config.description: Find hosts that external scanners have already flagged as exposing AI runtimes or related ports.
config.expected_signal: Rows naming external IPs and ports of known AI runtimes. Silence suggests no current exposure detected by external scanning.

primitive_config.label: Identify exposed AI services
primitive_config.content: SELECT domain_or_ip, port, product, provider FROM hb_exposed_assets WHERE (LOWER(product) LIKE '%ollama%' OR LOWER(product) LIKE '%jupyter%' OR port IN (11434, 8888, 8501, 8000))
primitive_config.expected: Rows naming external IPs and ports of known AI runtimes. Silence suggests no current exposure detected by external scanning.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, COUNT(*) AS lookups, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{tunnel_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname
config.description: Detect internal hosts resolving tunnel providers which indicates a successful callback or verification check.
config.expected_signal: Internal hosts attempting to connect to free tunnel providers. Silence means no known tunnel callbacks were initiated.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_path, src_endpoint_ip, status_code, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/api/tags%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/api/pull%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/api/push%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/api/kernels%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/api/contents%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/api/sessions%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')

config.expected_signal: HTTP requests from external IPs to administrative paths. Silence suggests no unauthenticated probing was logged.

config.question: the triage-ai-exposure verdict is malicious for at least one host

config.description: Direct the hunt based on the agent's assessment of compromise.
Stop further misuse or data exfiltration from the compromised runtime.
config.instructions: Isolate the host immediately. Revoke any linked Ollama account keys and check for unauthorized cloud spend.

config.description: Identify specific model names or encoded payloads that indicate the attacker's intent.
config.instructions: Read the model list on the affected host using the Ollama or Jupyter API. Look for model names prefixed with IP addresses or containing Base64 strings that decode to system paths.

config.description: Close the exposure gap for hosts that were not actively misused.
config.instructions: Bind the AI runtime to localhost or a private network. Implement an authenticating reverse proxy or zero-trust layer for remote access.
